record_note: Written 2026-10-06, after the fact: this repo was wired by hand from the kit's C++ templates (first commit d27b5a5, the Stage-A scaffold) before this record existed, so `revision` is NOT the exact copy point — it is the newest kit commit any recorded file was taken from (d888e29, the hook-tier fix), and the earlier entries came from kit revisions between then and now. Kind is `retroactive` for that reason. The two fixes in `adopted_fixes` are the two probes this copy carries; every other kit fix is neither claimed nor declined, which the record checker reports with the result of running the kit's probe against this gate — silence is not a claim. Rule that keeps this file true: any commit that edits a copied artifact updates that artifact's repo_sha256 in the same commit, and a commit that moves `revision` re-reads every kit_sha256. On 2026-10-06 the carried copy of tools/kit-probes/gitignore-footprint.sh was replaced with the kit's verbatim probe at 742ee17 (the probe that derives the footprint list from the gate under test) — the copy this repo had was hand-adapted, which a claim cannot prove. Its `from_revision` names that probe's own revision for the same reason; the recipe it guards came from acced82 (D15). **2026-10-06, probe re-sync:** the copy of tools/kit-probes/hook-tiers-agree.sh here was the one taken at d888e29. The probe gained two refinements while the fleet was ported -- it reads a full tier single-sourced as CI_DEFAULT_STAGES (four sibling repos spell it that way and have no list in their push hook at all), and it reads the gate's own --list before calling a stage a decoration, because JSOM's `coverage` is declared opt-in. Without them the probe reported those repos as having no tiers. The copy is the kit's current file, revision and adopted_fixes[hook-tiers-agree].from_revision both name 919006e, and every kit_sha256 is re-read at that copy point. **2026-10-06, card t_075c0a6f (KitCI fleet batch 2 of 3):** the gate is no longer a bash script. tools/ci.sh and the probes under tools/kit-probes/ are DELETED; the gate is the tracked gate.toml (11 stages, tiers fast/full) run by kit-ci, plus scripts/gate-env.sh, scripts/gate.sh and one scripts/<stage>.sh per stage — all of them this repo's own files, which is why none appears in files[] below. files[] loses tools/ci.sh and every tools/kit-probes/*.sh entry: the artifacts are gone, so no hash can describe them. The kit fixes those probes guarded move from adopted_fixes to declined_fixes — not because the fixes were declined, but because the artifact they CHECK no longer exists (each probe is written against a single bash gate file; measured against scripts/gate.sh, see INCIDENTS.md for the verdicts). The contracts did not go: each one has a named home, listed in INCIDENTS.md entry by entry. .githooks/pre-commit and .githooks/pre-push are RE-HASHED because this commit edits them: they now NAME a tier (--tier fast, and --tier full with CI_REQUIRE_CLEAN=1, the old --require-clean flag moved into the environment), and their branch for this repo's own tools/ci.sh is gone with that file. `revision` and every other entry are UNCHANGED: nothing here came from the kit, and being behind the kit is not a failure. **2026-10-07 (L3, card t_b2d659b3) — MARK, DON'T MEND:** `files[]` was last accurate at its recorded `revision` (98e517d); the fleet moved to KitCI on 2026-10-07 (L3) and the per-file fingerprint was retired for records written after it, so INCIDENTS.md's stale hash is marked `fingerprints_retired` rather than re-read — drift after that is unrecorded by policy. The `.ci.env.example` entry also gains the `adapted_why` the L3 conversion left off.

Adapted 2026-10-06 (card t_075c0a6f, the KitCI conversion): four edits, all of them re-pointing prose at the new gate. (1) the header's "default in tools/ci.sh" now reads "scripts/gate-env.sh"; (2) the `CI_DEFAULT_STAGES="tree format kitprobes build tests release version asan tsan tidy pristine"` line is replaced by the note that the stage LIST moved to gate.toml's tiers, that scripts/gate-env.sh still reads the three CI_*_STAGES variables but they no longer select the run, and that CI_STRICT_TOOLS has no equivalent; (3) `tools/ci.sh --write-tidy-baseline` -> `scripts/write-tidy-baseline.sh`; (4) "tidy_key in tools/ci.sh" -> "scripts/gate-env.sh". Measured: the diff against the kit blob at 98e517d is exactly these four hunks (15 changed lines). Byte-identical to FSMTable's copy of the same file.
